cd /workspace && cat > fuzz/mutate_test.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: mutate_test.sh "<sed-pattern-replacement-file>"
set -u
cd /workspace
cp submission/te/session.py /tmp/sess_orig.py
cp submission/te/engine.py /tmp/eng_orig.py
run_tests() {
  out=$(LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 fuzz/cases.py 2>&1 | tail -1)
  out2=$(LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 fuzz/run_fuzz.py 40 9 2>&1 | tail -1)
  echo "cases:$out | fuzz:$out2"
}
for mut in "$@"; do
  cp /tmp/sess_orig.py submission/te/session.py
  cp /tmp/eng_orig.py submission/te/engine.py
  python3 -c "
import sys
muts = '''$mut'''.split('||')
for fn, a, b in [m.split(':::') for m in muts]:
    s = open(fn).read()
    assert a in s, 'pattern not found: ' + a
    s = s.replace(a, b)
    open(fn, 'w').write(s)
"
  echo "--- mutation: $mut"
  run_tests
done
cp /tmp/sess_orig.py submission/te/session.py
cp /tmp/eng_orig.py submission/te/engine.py
echo "--- restored"
run_tests
EOF
chmod +x fuzz/mutate_test.sh
./fuzz/mutate_test.sh \
 "submission/te/session.py:::st['u'] = st['u'] * (st['rho'] / new):::pass" \
 "submission/te/session.py:::st['fresh'] = set():::pass" \

 "submission/te/session.py:::if st['r'] - st['accept_round'][w] > max_lag:::if st['r'] - st['accept_round'][w] >= max_lag"
